description: Cross-SDK vectors for the HTTP mandate presentation (Aroha-Mandate header, spec section 6.9.2). Generated by packages/aroha-credentials/scripts/gen-http-presentation-vectors.ts; do not edit by hand. Bodies are base64url of the exact body bytes (empty string = empty body). 'now' is the verifier's clock. A conforming SDK reproduces every 'expected' field byte for byte and reaches the same verdict and code.

presentations.name: post-json-absolute-url
presentations.description: Client signs the absolute URL; the server sees origin-form req.url. Body is the exact JSON bytes.

presentations.name: get-empty-body-lowercase-method-root-query
presentations.description: Method is upper-cased; an empty path becomes '/'; an empty body hashes as SHA-256 of the empty string.

presentations.name: put-binary-body-percent-encoded-path
presentations.description: Percent-escapes are signed as sent, never decoded; the body is arbitrary bytes.

presentations.name: cart-chain-ttl-capped
presentations.description: A delegated cart presented by its grantee; a requested ttl above 5 minutes is capped at 5 minutes.
